flow.context: A CreditMantri collections agent is on a phone call about a missed loan EMI. The caller may reply in English, Hindi, Tamil, or a mix (Hinglish, Tanglish). `caller_reply` is a speech-to-text transcript and may contain recognition errors.

lines.intro: Hello, I'm calling from CreditMantri. My name is Ananya.
lines.reassure: I'm calling from CreditMantri about an account-related matter. For privacy, I can only discuss it with {{full_name}}. Is that you?
lines.recording: Thank you. Please note that this call is recorded for quality purposes.
lines.emi_status: I'm calling about your {{loan_type}} ending {{last4_spoken}}. Your EMI of {{emi_words}}, due on {{due_date_words}}, could not be collected because {{reason}}.
lines.ask_when: When would you be able to make this payment?
lines.pay_now_1: Perfect. I'm sending a secure payment link to your registered mobile number right now.
lines.pay_now_2: It should arrive in a few seconds. Could you let me know once you've received it?
lines.resend: I've sent it again. The message comes from CreditMantri. You can also pay in the CreditMantri app, under Pay EMI.
lines.pay_close: Thank you, {{first_name}}. Once you pay {{total_words}}, it will reflect in your account within two hours.
lines.ptp_today: Thank you. I've noted that you'll make the payment today, {{date_today}}.
lines.ptp_tomorrow: Thank you. I've noted that you'll make the payment tomorrow, {{date_tomorrow}}.
lines.ptp_3days: Thank you. I've noted that you'll make the payment by {{date_3days}}.
lines.ptp_week: Thank you. I've noted that you'll make the payment by {{date_week}}.
lines.ptp_later: I understand. To avoid further charges, the latest date I can note is {{date_week}}. Would that work for you?
lines.ptp_unspecified: Could you tell me a specific date by which you'll be able to pay?
lines.ptp_sms: I'll also send you the payment link by SMS, so it's handy when you're ready.
lines.already_paid_1: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take up to forty-eight hours to reflect. Could you tell me the date you paid?
lines.already_paid_2: Thank you. I've raised a verification request. Once it's confirmed, you can ignore any reminders.
lines.hardship: I understand, and I'm sorry to hear that. I can send you a link to pay part of the amount now, or I can arrange a call from our customer relief team to discuss a revised plan. Which would you prefer?
lines.partial_link: Sure. I'm sending the link now. You can enter any amount you're comfortable with, and it will be adjusted against your EMI.
lines.relief: Done. Our customer relief team will call you within twenty-four hours, and you won't receive reminder calls until then.
lines.dispute: I'm sorry for the trouble. I've raised a review request for this payment. Our team will contact you within forty-eight hours.
lines.waiver: I'm not able to waive the charge on this call, but I've flagged your request to our team. If it's approved, it will be adjusted in your next statement.
lines.mandate_fix: I'm sending you a link to set up auto-debit on your active bank account. It takes about two minutes, and your future EMIs will go through automatically.
lines.busy: No problem. When would be a good time to call you back?
lines.cb_evening: Sure, I'll call you back this evening. Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.cb_tomorrow_morning: Sure, I'll call you back tomorrow morning. Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.cb_tomorrow_evening: Sure, I'll call you back tomorrow evening. Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.cb_generic: Sure, I'll call you back at a better time. Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.wrong_person: I'm sorry for the trouble. Do you happen to know {{full_name}}?
lines.wp_knows: Could you please ask them to call CreditMantri on 1800 123 4567? Thank you, and sorry for the disturbance.
lines.wp_unknown: My apologies for the disturbance. We'll update our records. Have a good day.
lines.third_party: No problem. Could you please ask {{first_name}} to call CreditMantri back on 1800 123 4567? Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Have a good day!
lines.human: Sure, I'm transferring you to a CreditMantri representative. Please hold.
lines.stop_calling: Understood. I've noted your request. You can reach us anytime on 1800 123 4567. Goodbye.
lines.abusive: I understand you're upset. I'll end the call here. You can reach us on 1800 123 4567. Goodbye.
lines.didnt_catch: Sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you say that again?

listens.question: The agent asked to confirm the identity of the person who picked up the phone. How did they respond in `caller_reply`?

intents.description: They confirm they are the named person (yes, speaking, haan)
They say it is a wrong number or that they are not the person and do not know them
phrases: no you have the wrong number

intents.description: Someone else who knows the named person answered (family, colleague); the person is not available
They are the named person but are busy and ask to talk later
They ask who is calling or why before confirming who they are

listens.question: The agent told the customer their EMI payment failed and asked when they can pay. What does `caller_reply` express?

intents.description: They want to pay right now or today on this call, or ask for the payment link now
They commit to paying later, with or without a specific date or day
They say they have already paid this EMI
They say they cannot pay because of money problems, job loss, medical or other hardship
They dispute the amount or the bounce, or say it is the bank's or lender's mistake
They ask for the bounce charge or late fee to be removed or waived
They say their bank account or auto-debit changed and ask how to update or fix the auto-debit mandate
They are busy and ask to talk later

slots.question: If the caller in `caller_reply` commits to paying, by when do they say they will pay? Today is given in `today`.

options.description: Today, later today, tonight, or right after this call
Within the next two or three days, or by a date up to three days away
Within a week: this week, by the weekend, or a date four to seven days away
More than a week away: next month, after salary, or a date over seven days away
No time given, or it is unclear when

listens.question: The agent sent a payment link by SMS and asked the customer to confirm when it arrives. What does `caller_reply` say?

intents.description: They received the link, or have already paid through it
They have not received the link yet

listens.question: The agent asked if there is anything else it can help with. What does `caller_reply` say?

intents.description: Nothing else; they are done, say thanks or bye

listens.question: The agent offered the latest payment date it can note and asked if that works. What does `caller_reply` say?

intents.description: They agree to pay by that date
They cannot pay by that date

listens.question: The customer said they already paid, and the agent asked for the date of payment. What does `caller_reply` say?

intents.description: They give a date or day when they paid
They do not remember the date or will check later

listens.question: The agent offered two options: a link to pay part of the amount now, or a call from the customer relief team. Which does `caller_reply` choose?

intents.description: They want to pay part of the amount now / the partial payment link
They want the call from the customer relief team or a revised plan

listens.question: The agent asked when would be a good time to call back. When does `caller_reply` want the callback?

intents.description: Later today or this evening
Tomorrow morning
Tomorrow afternoon or evening
Some other specific or vague time

listens.question: The person who answered is not the customer. The agent asked if they know the customer. What does `caller_reply` say?

intents.description: Yes, they know the person
No, they do not know the person

globalIntents.description: They did not hear or understand and want the agent to repeat what it just said
They ask the agent to wait a moment, or to stop talking and listen ("one minute", "wait", "hold on", "stop, listen to me"), without asking to end the call
They ask to speak to a human, a manager, or a real person

They explicitly ask CreditMantri never to call them again or to take their number off the list ("stop calling me", "don't call this number again"). Not "stop" or "please stop" said to make the agent stop talking or listen to them
They are abusive, threatening, or using profanity at the agent

idle.finalLine: I'm unable to hear you, so I'll call back later. Goodbye.
